name: Zhu
source:
Naturally warm and caring, Zhu inspires trust and connection, leading others with kindness and determination.

He hides his emotional wounds, neglecting his own needs while taking on the struggles of everyone around him.

After enduring years of abuse from a parent, Zhu escaped at 18 and found purpose in helping troubled youth at a center, masking his own pain behind positivity.
